title: Generate Parentheses
summary: Return every balanced string containing n opening and n closing parentheses.

contractDetails.output-checking: Require every distinct string once in any outer order.

statement: Return every balanced string containing n opening and n closing parentheses. In any prefix the number of closing parentheses must not exceed the number of opening parentheses. The output list may be in any order.

examples.explanation: The pairs are nested or adjacent.
All five strings keep every prefix valid.

hints: Conceptual: A prefix with too many closing parentheses cannot be repaired.
Directional: Track both counts during generation.
Implementation: Add an opening parenthesis while openings remain. Add a closing one only while an opening is unmatched.
complexityAnalysis: O(n·Cₙ) time and O(n) auxiliary space excluding output, where Cₙ is the n-th Catalan number.
